ladder.why: The structure itself: one node per prefix plus an end flag, so search and startsWith differ only in that flag.
A counter on each node of how many words pass through it answers 'how many start with p' by walking p; insert and delete adjust one path.
Each typed prefix is one trie node, so keeping the best three words per node turns autocomplete into one step per character.

ladder.teaches: a trie plus DFS to search many words at once
ladder.why: A '.' forces the walk to branch into every child: find becomes a DFS through the trie.

ladder.teaches: a bitwise trie for the maximum XOR
ladder.why: Numbers as bit strings in a trie, walked greedily toward the opposite bit from the top, because one high bit beats all lower bits.

ladder.teaches: a trie plus DFS to search many words at once
ladder.why: One grid DFS that walks the trie alongside the board searches for every word at once and abandons dead prefixes immediately.
Digit strings in a trie: the depth another number reaches walking down is its longest common prefix with the whole first array.
Prefix pairs counted with per-node end and pass counters as words are inserted one by one.
Suffix questions become prefix questions after reversing each word, then counting with a trie.

ladder.teaches: a bitwise trie for the maximum XOR
ladder.why: An OA story that reduces to the maximum XOR of two prefix XORs, answered with a bitwise trie.

ladder.teaches: a trie plus DFS to search many words at once
ladder.why: Backtracking where a trie of prefixes supplies only the words that can still fit the columns already fixed.
A live autocomplete: the query is a moving trie node, a DFS below it gathers candidates, and frequencies are updated as sentences are committed.

notes: Bitwise trie had no candidates in the pool; inmobi-maximum-xor-between-two-arrays and tiktok-maximum-value came from the free bank. mt-search-myterious-grid (in the pool) is not really a trie problem, and squarepoint-suggested-products duplicates citadel-search-suggestions with a thin statement, so both were left out.
